title: A new MAR is saved as a Draft
steps: 1) Projects > Riyadh Gate Tower - Phase 2 > Submittals > New Submittal > Material Approval Request. 2) Subject "UAT SUB-01 Lighting Fixtures", Trade Electrical Works, Location Tower 1 Floor 02, Manufacturer Philips, Approved supplier Najd Electrical Supplies, Description empty. 3) Save Draft.
expected: The Draft is listed in the Drafts Stage with "No number yet" and no Step Age dots. It is Hafiz's to edit. What other Companies see: VIS-01.

title: Send for Review is refused while the Form is incomplete
steps: 1) Open the Draft from SUB-01. 2) Send for Review with Description and Datasheet (PDF) empty.
expected: Refused: the Form lists what is missing ("2 fields need your attention: Description, Datasheet (PDF)") and marks each field. Nothing moves; the item stays a Draft with no number.
covers: Rules: Form engine form_incomplete; README walkthrough step 2

title: The MAR Form takes Items, totals and Documents
steps: 1) Fill Description, Model "CoreLine Panel", Specification section "26 51 00". 2) Under Items, Add row twice: "Recessed panel" 200 Pieces and "Surface panel" 40 Pieces. 3) Save and close, then open the Draft again from the list. 4) Add a PDF under Datasheet (PDF) and a JPEG with EXIF under Sample photo.
expected: The total reads 240. Save and close returns to the Submittals list. The Datasheet and Sample photo can be added once the Draft is saved; the photo shows the time and place from its EXIF. The Attachments and Links System Fields sit below the Form.
covers: Rules: MAR Form Version 6; README walkthrough step 3

title: Send for Review numbers the item and Ali holds it at once
steps: 1) Hafiz: Send for Review on the complete Draft. 2) Ali: open it from the bell.
expected: The item gets a Document Number (first in a fresh seed: TWR-MAR-01-0004) shown left to right. Ali is TMC's only PM, so it is his at once: "With Ali Sonour - TMC Constructions", no Pick up button. Ali's bell shows "Step reached" within seconds. Nothing outside TMC.
covers: Matrix: 2; Rules: pool of one (ADR 0018), Document Numbers

title: A Return stays in Internal Review
steps: 1) Ali: Return with the reason "Add emergency duration". 2) Hafiz opens the item.
expected: The item stays in the Internal Review Stage, now at the Contractor Engineer Step, keeps its Document Number and goes back to Hafiz ("With Hafiz Hamdan - TMC Constructions"); it is never a Draft again. The reason is in TMC's history marked internal. Step Age counts from the Return.

title: Documents change until the Submit
steps: 1) Hafiz: remove the Datasheet and add a corrected PDF. 2) Send for Review again. 3) Ali opens the item and its Documents.
expected: Hafiz can swap Documents while the item is in TMC. Ali sees the corrected PDF. Documents freeze at the Submit, not before.
covers: Rules: Documents freeze at the first Submit

title: Submit with a Cover Note and an Internal Note
steps: 1) Ali: Submit; Cover Note "Panels for Level 2, as drawing E-201"; Internal Note "Quantities checked against the BOQ"; confirm. 2) Ahmed opens the item.
expected: Stage is Pending Approval. TMC sees "With Design Consultants LLC", never a Consultant's name. Ahmed's history shows the Submit with the Cover Note by "TMC Constructions" (no person); the Internal Note is not there. The Submission Date is set.
covers: Matrix: 3, 34; Rules: Cover Note, V5, V14

title: Pick up and Return to pool in the Consultant pool
steps: 1) Ahmed and Sara open the Submitted MAR. 2) Ahmed: Pick up. 3) Sara refreshes Need My Action and her bell. 4) Ahmed: Return to pool, then Pick up again.
expected: Both Engineers see "not picked up yet: ..." with both names; Mohammed is not in this pool and reads it read-only. After Pick up the item leaves Sara's Need My Action and her unread "Step reached" is withdrawn; Return to pool is offered because the pool has two Members and does not bring the notification back.

title: The Consultant reads the Form and cannot edit it
steps: 1) After Pick up, read every Form section, open the Datasheet PDF and the Sample photo. 2) Try to change an answer.
expected: Every answer, the Items table and the total are shown read-only; Documents are frozen; the photo shows time and place. No edit control is offered (the Form is the raiser's).

title: Send to Manager needs the verification
steps: 1) Ahmed: Send to Manager with the verification empty. 2) Answer Sample checked Yes, Matches specification No; leave the Verification note empty. 3) Write the note, set Recommended Code C and an Internal Note. 4) Confirm.
expected: Steps 1 and 2 are refused: the Verification note becomes required when Matches specification is No. After step 4 the item sits with Mohammed, the only Consultant Manager, at once. Ahmed's answers, Recommended Code and Internal Note are in DCL's history only, marked internal.
covers: Matrix: 7; Rules: V5, Screens (ADR 0019), Recommended Code

title: Code A closes the item with the final verification
steps: 1) Open the item; Approve A. 2) Check the Final verification pop-up is filled from Ahmed's reply; Remarks left empty. 3) Confirm.
expected: Remarks are optional with Code A. The item closes Approved, Code A, and accepts no more moves. Download PDF appears (SIG-02).
covers: Rules: Review Code A; Remarks optional with A

title: Code B turns each comment into a Comment
steps: 1) On a new Submitted MAR, Mohammed: Approve with Comments B with three comment rows and Remarks. 2) Ali opens the MAR and the Snag List.
expected: The MAR closes at Code B. Three Comment items are in the Snag List, raised by Design Consultants and Open with TMC. The MAR page reads "Comments: 3 open / 0 closed". Remarks are required with B.

title: Code C needs Remarks and Return to Engineer works
steps: 1) Ahmed sends a MAR to Mohammed with Matches specification No. 2) Mohammed: Return to Engineer, reason "Check the photometric report". 3) Ahmed sends it again unchanged. 4) Mohammed: Revise and Resubmit C with Remarks empty, then with Remarks.
expected: Return to Engineer gives it back to Ahmed. Code C is refused until Remarks are written, then closes at C with its Remarks and final verification. TMC is offered Create Revision (SUB-15).
covers: Rules: Remarks required with C; README walkthrough step 13

title: Code D offers a replacement, not a Revision
steps: 1) Mohammed: Reject D with Remarks. 2) Hafiz opens the closed MAR and chooses Create replacement.
expected: The item closes at D. Hafiz is offered Create replacement (no Revision). The replacement is a new Draft with the same Subject, a Replaces Link to the rejected MAR, and gets a new Document Number with no Rev suffix at its first send.

title: Create a Revision of a Code C item
steps: 1) Open the MAR you took to Code C in SUB-13 (the seeded Cable tray risers item already has an open Rev 1, so it offers no new Revision) and Create Revision. 2) The Draft reads Revision 1, No number yet; change the Model, Save and close. 3) Open the Revision drop-down. 4) Send for Review and have Ali Submit it.
expected: The Draft starts with TMC's answers and the copied Datasheet. The drop-down lists the original and Revision 1 (no number yet); after the Submit it lists the number and the number Rev 1, each whole and left to right. Choosing the original shows its own answers, Code C, Remarks and history. A Revision uses no counter.

title: Delete discards a Draft only
steps: 1) On a Draft that never left Draft, row menu > Delete, confirm. 2) On a numbered item look at its row menu.
expected: The confirm says nobody will see the Draft again, Hafiz included, and no number is lost; it leaves the list. A numbered item has no Delete (an issued item is never deleted).

title: Duplicate copies only TMC's own work
steps: 1) On a closed MAR that Mohammed answered, row menu > Duplicate. 2) Open the new Draft.
expected: A new Draft with the Subject, TMC's own answers and the Documents and photos TMC uploaded, as new files. None of Design Consultants' verification, Remarks or notes. "Duplicated from" shows the original's number to TMC only.

title: Download gives the item as it last arrived
steps: 1) On a Submitted MAR choose Download from the row menu as Ali, then as Mohammed. 2) Try Download on a Draft.
expected: Both get the same content: shared answers, shared moves by Company only, no Step, no person, no Internal Note. A Draft offers nothing to download.

title: Related submittals and free Links open the other item
steps: 1) Open "Emergency lighting control panel - Tower 2". 2) Links: open TWR-MAR-01-0001 from Related submittals and from the free Link. 3) On TWR-MAR-01-0001 scroll to Linked from.
expected: Each Link shows the Document Number (left to right) and Subject and opens the item; a Submitted item cannot be changed. Linked from on the exit signs lists the control panel. Linking notifies nobody.
covers: Rules: Link, E1; README walkthrough step 10

title: A SAR closed at Code A adds the supplier to the list
steps: 1) Raise a Supplier Approval Request "UAT SUB-20 Delta Cables" (Electrical), send, Submit. 2) Ahmed picks up and sends to Manager; Mohammed: Approve A. 3) Project Settings > Approved Supplier List.
expected: The SAR runs 2 to 2 and closes. "UAT SUB-20 Delta Cables" is listed for Electrical, approved. A second SAR for the same name in other letter case adds no second entry. A MAR now offers it under Approved supplier.

title: A DAR ends with the Owner's review
who: Hafiz; Ali; Mohammed; Noura (Al Waha PM)
steps: 1) Raise a Document Approval Request "UAT SUB-21 Cable schedule", send, Ali Submits. 2) Mohammed recommends Code A to the Owner. 3) Noura opens it and chooses Confirm.
expected: Mohammed's Recommendation goes to Noura, who holds the Owner's review; Confirm issues Code A and closes the item. TMC sees it "With Owner review" until then (VIS-27).

title: Watch and Unwatch
steps: 1) Open a Submitted MAR; note Watching (raiser and Submitter watch from the start). 2) Unwatch, then Watch again.
expected: The button flips between Watch and Watching. Nobody sees who else watches an item or how many.

title: List: search, filters, Need My Action, sort and columns
steps: 1) Submittals List: search by Document Number, Subject, Type, Trade, Location. 2) Filter panel: pick several values for Type, Stage, With, Step Age, Submission Date. 3) Toggle Need My Action. 4) Sort by a column; Columns > move one > Save as my default; reload. 5) Group by Stage.
expected: Results match the filters; Stage counts match the rows; Need My Action keeps only items waiting on Ali (his own Drafts stay in view, uncounted); the saved columns come back after reload; the column header for the holder reads With.

title: List export holds what the viewer sees
steps: 1) Export > what you see > CSV, then Excel. 2) Export the whole table. 3) Search first, then export. 4) Put =1+1 in the Subject of a Draft and export.
expected: Rows and columns equal the screen; the whole table adds every List field; under a search only the rows read so far; a cell that looks like a formula is written as text.

title: Kanban: columns, counts and moving a card
steps: 1) Kanban: columns are the Stages with counts. 2) Drag a card, or use Move to, to a Stage Ali's Step allows. 3) Open the filter panel (Owner, Role, Created date).
expected: Dropping or choosing a move opens the same Action Form as the item page; the card moves after confirm; a move that is not allowed is not offered. Internal Review shows TMC's own Steps with counts (Engineer, PM). The other Company is one lane by its name.

title: Project Dashboard: Type cards and Activity Feed
steps: 1) Open the Project (Dashboard). 2) Click a number on a Type card.
expected: Type cards show counts over what Ali sees; each number opens the List with the same filter and the same count. The Activity Feed sits beside them; it lists Company names for other Companies and no person of theirs.

title: Home: counts, Need My Action list, Recent activity
steps: 1) Open Home. 2) Compare Active Projects, Need My Action, My Company 4+ weeks at step, My Company waiting with others and each Project card's submittal count with the Project's List.
expected: Every number equals the sum of the Project reads and opens the matching list; Drafts are never counted as Need My Action; Recent activity shows at most four entries.

title: Activity Feed page
steps: 1) Project > Activity Feed after some Submits and Codes.
expected: Entries read as events (submitted, returned, approved) with the Project; TMC appears by Company name only; no answers_changed or Document upload entries.

title: No due dates, deadlines or SLAs anywhere
steps: 1) Visit Home, Projects, Dashboard, List, Kanban, item page and the emails in Mailpit, in EN and AR. 2) Search the page text for due, deadline, SLA, late and every other term GLOSSARY.md lists under Avoid for Step Age (and the Arabic equivalents).
expected: Only Step Age dots (1 to 4+ weeks) show age. No due date, deadline or SLA appears. The List and Kanban headers use the GLOSSARY words: Stage not Status, Trade not Discipline, With not Current owner.

title: Every Member reads the Project Workflows
steps: 1) Project > Settings > Workflows. 2) Open the MAR Workflow and a published Version.
expected: The page lists which Workflow each Work Item Type runs, its Version and every published Version whole, with every Company's Steps and Returns. Neither can open the builder or see a draft.

title: View workflow on an item pins its Version
steps: 1) Open a Submitted MAR; click Workflow: name, Version n. 2) Switch map and list. 3) Open the same item as Ahmed and move it between DCL Steps.
expected: The drawer shows the Version the item is pinned to. Ali's own Steps are shown one by one; Design Consultants is one part marked With Design Consultants LLC. Ahmed sending to Mohammed changes nothing Ali reads.

title: Duplicate a Rabaed Default into the Project
steps: 1) Settings > Workflows > duplicate the MAR Workflow as "UAT MAR copy". 2) Open it.
expected: A draft Version 1 of a new Project Workflow with no link to the original. Only Project Admins see it.

title: Builder: add a Step, connect, undo, auto-layout
steps: 1) Open the copy in the builder. 2) Drag a Step from the palette into a Stage band; connect two Steps by dragging from a dot. 3) Undo and redo (Ctrl+Z, Ctrl+Shift+Z). 4) Auto-layout; switch Curved and Orthogonal arrows. 5) Select a Transition: edit labels (EN and AR), kind, Screen.
expected: Edits autosave a moment later. The kind follows the publish checks (Submit across Participants, Return back within one). A connection onto empty canvas adds a New step. Auto-layout arranges Steps by route inside each Stage band; the arrow style is kept per viewer.

title: Validate reports problems and Publish needs a Change Note
steps: 1) In the copy, leave a Step with no way forward. 2) Validate. 3) Fix it, Publish with no Change Note, then with one.
expected: Validate counts the errors and selects the first; Publish lists what changed, the count of items that keep their Version and requires the Change Note. After publishing the builder stays open.

title: A new Version applies to new items only
steps: 1) Bind the published copy to MAR (Settings > Workflows > Use for MAR). 2) Hafiz raises a new MAR. 3) Open an older MAR.
expected: The new MAR runs the new Version; the older item keeps its Version and shows a notice that a later Version exists. Binding another Workflow reaches only items created afterwards.

title: Versions history shows Change Notes and running counts
steps: 1) Open the Workflow's Versions page. 2) Compare two Versions.
expected: Newest first with date and Change Note; the N running figure counts only items the reader sees; Compare marks added, removed and changed. Hafiz sees Versions but no Change Note.

title: Exception for one Participant must not name it
steps: 1) Copy MAR as "Beta Build MARs" and try to bind it as an exception for Beta Build. 2) Rename it "MARs, short route" and bind it for Beta Build.
expected: The first is refused because the name holds a Participant's name. The second binds; Yousef's new MARs run it, TMC's do not. Others learn of no Participant.

title: Build a Workflow with a Send Back (fixture FX-SB)
steps: 1) Copy the MAR Workflow. 2) Add a Send Back from Consultant Engineer to the Contractor Draft Step; on the Draft Step set After a Send Back to Comment only (and a second copy to Edit the Form). 3) Validate, Publish, bind.
expected: It validates and publishes. If publish refuses the Send Back, record a Bug: VIS-15 and VIS-16 need this Workflow.

title: Drafts visible to: the author only
steps: 1) In a copy, set the Draft Step to Drafts visible to the author only; publish and bind. 2) Hafiz saves a Draft. 3) Omar and Ali open the List and the item URL.
expected: Omar and Ali see no Draft, no count, and the 404 page; Hafiz sees and edits it. After Send for Review TMC reads it as before.

title: Transition rules: Restrict, Validate and Effects
steps: 1) In a copy open a Transition > Add rule. 2) Add Restrict by Position, a Validate with a message in EN and AR, an Effect Offer Assign to. 3) Test run the Workflow.
expected: Rules show under Condition with AND between Restrict rules; Test run opens each pop-up in test mode and saves nothing; a Transition whose Restrict fails is not offered.

title: Return goes to the author, not the other engineer
steps: 1) Omar (Tower 2 only) and Hafiz both cover a Tower 2 item. 2) Hafiz sends a Tower 2 Draft for review. 3) Ali Returns it.
expected: It goes back to Hafiz, who sent it, not to Omar.

title: Stages and Outcomes pages
steps: 1) Settings > Stages: rename a Stage, add one. 2) Settings > Outcomes. 3) As Ali open the same pages.
expected: Project Admin changes show in the Stage set, List and Kanban columns; Ali reads them and cannot change them. Another Project is unchanged.

title: Library: save, mark default, new Project copies it
steps: 1) Library > Workflows: Save a Project Workflow to the Library. 2) Mark it default for MAR. 3) Create a new Project.
expected: The Library copy has no link to the original; the new Project starts with a copy as its MAR Workflow, bound. A plain Member sees the Library read-only.

title: Step Age dots count from the current Step
steps: 1) Precondition: ask the lane engineer to age two items (fixture AGE) by 1 and by 4 weeks. 2) Read the dots in the List, Kanban and item page for Ali and for Mohammed.
expected: Dots show 1 to 4+ weeks (4+ all red). For the holder's Company they count from the current Step; the other Company counts from when the item reached it. A Draft shows none. No due date appears.
covers: Matrix: 35, RP-407-4; Rules: Step Age, V14

title: Cancel from the raiser's Steps, only until the first Submit
steps: 1) Hafiz: new MAR "UAT Cancel", Save Draft, Cancel; confirm. 2) Make a second MAR, Send for Review; Ali opens it and Cancels. 3) Make a third, Submit it to DCL; look for Cancel as Ali and Hafiz.
expected: Cancel is offered at the Draft, the Contractor Engineer and the Internal Review Steps and asks for confirmation; the item goes to the Cancelled Stage with no outcome. Once Submitted, Cancel is no longer offered. A Revision never offers Cancel. Carried over from RP-463 B-09 (RP-490).
covers: Rules: workflow-engine 5.1 Cancel, RP-437; RP-463: B-09

title: Assign to offers only your own Company's Members
steps: 1) Saeed: in the Project's MAR Workflow (fixture FX-SB copy) add Assign to on Send for Review and on Submit; publish. 2) Hafiz: new MAR, Send for Review, open Assign to. 3) Ali: Submit, open Assign to.
expected: Hafiz is offered only TMC Members who may hold the Contractor PM Step; Ali only TMC Members (never a DCL engineer by name; the Consultant is one Participant). A pick it could not have offered is refused like a made-up one. Carried over from RP-463 B-06 (RP-487).
covers: Matrix: RP-431-2; Rules: V14, Refusals row; RP-463: B-06

title: The three submittal Forms carry the documented fields
steps: 1) New Submittal > MAR, then SAR, then DAR. 2) Read each Form top to bottom in EN.
expected: MAR: Manufacturer, Approved supplier (required), Model, Specification section, Description, Items table with total, Datasheet (PDF), Test certificate, Sample photo, Related submittals, Trade, Location, Scopes. SAR and DAR have Forms of their own. Subject and Document Number sit above, Attachments and Links below.

title: Required fields to leave Draft
steps: 1) Save a MAR Draft with each of Manufacturer, Description, Datasheet, Trade, Location empty in turn. 2) Send for Review.
expected: Manufacturer, Description, the Datasheet, Trade and Location are required to leave Draft; a Draft saves with any missing. Each missing field is named and marked.

title: Approved supplier offers the Trade's list only
steps: 1) In a MAR choose Trade Civil Works: open Approved supplier. 2) Change Trade to Electrical Works.
expected: Civil offers Al-Rimal Building Materials; Electrical offers Najd Electrical Supplies and Tabuk Cable Industries (and any supplier added since by a SAR or the Project Admin). Changing Trade clears the supplier.

title: Trade, Location and Scopes are Built-in Fields
steps: 1) Pick Location Tower 1, then Floor. 2) Pick Scopes Lighting and Emergency lighting. 3) Try to remove Trade from the Form view.
expected: Locations nest Zone > Tower > Floor; Scopes belong to the Trade. Trade, Location and Scopes cannot be removed or made optional.

title: Related submittals offers only Submitted items Hafiz sees
steps: 1) In a Draft MAR type "control panel" under Related submittals. 2) Also search for a Draft of Hafiz's own and for Beta Build's item.
expected: Only Submitted items Hafiz sees in this Project appear; no Drafts, nothing in internal review, nothing of Beta Build. A saved id that could not be offered is refused like a made-up one.

title: Photos keep time and place; Take a photo on a phone
steps: 1) At 375 px open a Draft MAR; under Sample photo choose Take a photo (or Upload a JPEG with EXIF). 2) Save. 3) Open the photo.
expected: On a phone Take a photo is offered beside Upload. The thumbnail shows, and opening the photo shows the time and place from its EXIF.

title: Documents freeze at the first Submit
steps: 1) Hafiz adds and removes a Document in a Draft. 2) After Ali Submits, Hafiz opens the item. 3) Ahmed opens the Documents.
expected: Before the Submit Documents can change; after it they are frozen for everyone and cannot be removed. Ahmed opens them with a short-lived link.

title: The Form belongs to the raiser; replies are Screens
steps: 1) Ahmed Send to Manager: read the pop-up fields. 2) Mohammed Approve: read the Code pop-up. 3) Open the Form as Mohammed.
expected: Replies are pop-up Screens (verification, Recommended Code, final verification, Remarks); no Form field is editable by the Consultant. Fields a Screen marks internal never reach TMC.

title: Screens: read, edit and publish in Project Settings
steps: 1) Settings > Screens: open Code reply. 2) Edit a copy, publish a new Version. 3) Start a MAR and take it to the Code; compare the pop-up.
expected: Every Member reads Screens; only Project Admins change them. An item already running keeps the Screen Version its Workflow Version pinned; new Workflow Versions pick the new one.

title: Draft autosave shows Saved and survives a failed save
steps: 1) Edit a Draft; watch the Saved time. 2) Go offline in the browser, edit, go online.
expected: The Saved time moves with each save. A failed save is shown clearly with a retry; no edit is lost.

title: Member and Participant fields offer only what the filler may see
steps: 1) On an item with a member or participant field (if the Form offers one) open the choices.
expected: Only TMC's own Project Members and TMC and the Host Company are offered; other Companies' people never. After the Submit another Company reads the answer as TMC's name, no person.
waits: Not scheduled: no Rabaed Default Form has a member or participant field; arrives with the Form builder

title: Sign in, wrong password and sign out
steps: 1) Open lane 7 /en/sign-in. 2) Wrong password. 3) Right password (in .env.demo). 4) Sign out. 5) Open a Project URL while signed out.
expected: The wrong password gives one generic refusal. Sign-in opens Home. After sign-out a Project URL goes to sign-in. Cookies are per host (lane7.localhost).

title: Invite a Member and accept the invitation
steps: 1) Members > Invite: a made-up .test email, name EN and AR, language. 2) Open the email in Mailpit and follow the link. 3) Set a password.
expected: The Member appears as invited, then active. The email arrives in Mailpit in the chosen language. The new Member belongs to TMC alone.

title: An email that belongs to another Company is refused without naming it
steps: 1) Members > Invite hafiz.hamdan@tmc.demo.rabaed.test.
expected: Refused: the person is already registered on Rabaed with another Company. TMC is never named and nothing else about Hafiz shows. An email of Hind's own Company gives the ordinary already-a-Member answer.

title: Create a Project
steps: 1) Projects > New Project: name EN and AR, code UATP, role Contractor. 2) Open it.
expected: The Project appears with Project Number in TMC's own series; Saeed is its first Project Admin; Host Company is TMC.

title: Trades, Locations and Scopes
steps: 1) Settings > Trades and Locations: add a Trade, a Zone, a Building, a Floor, a Scope and Sub-scope. 2) Ali opens the same page.
expected: Saeed adds; Ali reads Trades, Scopes and Locations and cannot add. Names show in EN and AR.

title: Invite a Company by CR number and accept
steps: 1) On a UAT Project invite CR 9999000003 as Consultant. 2) Layla: Company Projects shows the invitation (name, Host Company, offered role). 3) Accept.
expected: Until accepted, only Layla and the Project Admin see it; TMC's other Members do not. After accepting, DCL is a Participant in the role Consultant.

title: Grant Participant Visibility and read the Visibility Gap warning
steps: 1) Settings > Visibility: give the new Consultant Electrical only. 2) Remove all coverage of Mechanical from every Participant.
expected: The grant saves. A Visibility Gap warning names the value no active Participant covers. It is worked out from Participant grants alone.

title: The Authorized Person adds a Member to the Project with a Position and Visibility
steps: 1) Participants > the Project > add a Member with Position Engineer. 2) Open the Member's Visibility and narrow to Mechanical only. 3) Try to give a Trade the Participant lacks.
expected: The Member joins the Project. Narrowing saves. A Trade DCL does not cover is rejected (a Member never covers more than their Company).

title: Deactivate a Member: Handover first
steps: 1) Hafiz holds two Tower 2 MARs at Contractor Engineer (Omar covers Tower 2 as well) and one Tower 1 MAR (Omar does not cover it). 2) Saeed: Members > Deactivate Hafiz.
expected: The Handover dialog lists his open Steps and Drafts (Project, Document Number or No number yet, Subject, Step). The Tower 2 Steps pre-fill Omar as the single candidate. The Tower 1 Step has nobody else who can take it, so the change is refused with Nobody else can take <Step> on <Project>. Give someone the Position or Visibility first, naming only TMC's own Step and the Project; nothing saves until every Step has a new holder.

title: Participant Codes and Numbering settings
steps: 1) Settings > Numbering: read the pattern and examples. 2) Set a Participant Code (2 to 6 letters or digits). 3) Save a pattern that leaves out the Participant Code.
expected: Examples use the Admin's real next numbers. A code in use cannot change. Leaving out the Participant Code is refused until the shared-counter warning is accepted.

title: Show Inspections inside the Submittals tab
steps: 1) Settings > Modules: choose Inside the Submittals tab. 2) Open Submittals and the Project tabs.
expected: The Inspections tab is hidden; WIRs show in the Submittals List and Kanban with WIR as one more Type. Switching back restores the tab. Only a Project Admin changes it.

title: Approved Supplier List: add and withdraw by hand
steps: 1) Settings > Approved Supplier List: add a supplier for Mechanical; withdraw one. 2) Hafiz opens the list.
expected: Entries show name, Trade, Scope and status; a withdrawn one stays listed as withdrawn. Hafiz cannot add or withdraw. No source, person or time shows.

title: Company Projects page
steps: 1) Open Company Projects (sidebar).
expected: Each Project the Company takes part in shows name, code, number, Host Company, the Company's own Project Role and own Project Members, and pending invitations. Never another Participant.

title: Fixture FX-C2: narrow Beta Build to Tower 2
steps: 1) Settings > Visibility: set Beta Build Location to Tower 2 only. 2) Yousef signs in.
expected: The change saves (Yousef holds nothing, so no Handover). Yousef sees only Tower 2 items from then on, and TMC is the only Contractor covering Tower 1, which the Snag scenarios need.

title: Fixture FX-K1M: Sara covers Mechanical only
steps: 1) Open Sara's Visibility (Participants > Members). 2) Set Trade to Mechanical only.
expected: Sara no longer sees Electrical items and leaves their pools (Handover first if she holds one). Ahmed still covers both. Later scenarios use Sara as the K1 Mechanical-only engineer.

title: Fixture FX-OW: invite UAT Owner Co as Owner
who: Saeed (Project Admin); Reem UAT (Owner Co Authorized Person)
steps: 1) After ADM-02 onboards UAT Owner Co (CR 9999000005), Saeed invites that CR as Owner on Riyadh Gate Tower. 2) Reem accepts, grants Electrical and Mechanical, all Locations, and adds a PM Member (Sami UAT) with Position Project Manager.
expected: UAT Owner Co is a Participant with oversight over Submitted items it covers. Later Owner scenarios use it.

title: Packages is a third view beside List and Kanban
steps: 1) Submittals > the view toggle. 2) Choose Packages.
expected: A Packages Kanban with three columns Open, In Progress and Done, each with a count; a New Package button for a Company that can build one; search and filters (Trade, owning Company). Matches packages.html except where spec RP-616 differs.
waits: RP-588: Packages view and board counts (UI RP-659 to RP-662)

title: Open a Package and number it
steps: 1) New Package: name EN and AR. 2) Open it.
expected: The Package is numbered PKG-001 (left to right, also in Arabic) beside TMC's name, Open, with no submittals. A second Package is PKG-002. Beta Build's first Package is also PKG-001.
covers: Rules: Package numbering per owning Participant

title: Add submittals from Drafts and review
steps: 1) Open an Open Package > Add items. 2) Pick two Drafts and one item in internal review. 3) Try to add an item already in another Package.
